For a concave lens, the object distance u, image distance v, and focal length ƒ are negative according to the Cartesian sign convention. The image formed is always virtual, erect, and diminished, hence its distance from the lens is less than that of the object (|v| < |u|). Therefore, in the u-v graph, the curve lies below the reference line u = v. यह स्वयं की और बाहर की कोशिकाओं में विभेद कर सकती है।
